title: The Salt Tribunal
setting_summary: A floating arbitration court anchored in the North Sea, convened aboard a decommissioned oil platform converted into a tribunal, where a catastrophic desalination-plant collapse has left a coastal city without water and thousands displaced. The platform is cramped, storm-lashed, and under constant broadcast surveillance, with a hard deadline: the tribunal must deliver its verdict before the next supply ship arrives in fourteen days or the ruling is void. Every session is streamed live to a desperate public, and the judges' food, fuel, and communications are rationed by the very corporation standing trial.
